AGENTS.md

Source: AGENTS.md

Guidance for AI coding agents (and humans) working on globalhex.

What this is

An experimental R package that wraps the DGGRID command-line program (>= 9.0) in a small, H3-shaped API. Default grid: IGEO7 with Z7 indexes; ISEA3H/Z3 is also supported, plus an opt-in legacy path through dggridR. Cell IDs are DGGRID indexes, never H3 indexes.

Layout

  • R/grid.R – hex_grid(), legacy_grid(), DGGRID discovery (.find_dggrid()), globalhex_info()
  • R/cli.R – builds DGGRID metafiles and runs the executable as a subprocess
  • R/cell-class.R – the globalhex_cell vctrs class
  • R/convert.R, R/hierarchy.R, R/traversal.R – point/center/boundary conversion, parent/children, neighbors/disk/ring/distance
  • R/data.R, R/plot.R – lazy hex_data() tables, aggregation, level-of-detail plotting
  • R/raster.R, R/sf.R – terra/exactextractr and sf integration
  • R/compatibility.R – legacy dggridR fallback
  • R/conditions.R – .abort() and argument validators
  • tests/testthat/ – tests; helper-engine.R skips when DGGRID is missing
  • bench/ – development-only benchmarks (excluded from builds)
  • vignettes/ – getting started, plotting, rasters and polygons
  • inst/examples/ – runnable example scripts
  • src/dggrid/ – vendored, unmodified DGGRID 9.03b source (commit e9bb18a); do not edit
  • src/Makevars, src/install.libs.R – compile DGGRID without GDAL and install it to bin/
  • work/ – local demo outputs; not part of the package

Commands

Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'       # run tests
Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'   # regenerate man/ and NAMESPACE
Rscript -e 'devtools::check()'      # full R CMD check

devtools::load_all()/test() compile src/dggrid/dggrid and use it directly. The first build compiles ~140 C++ files and takes a minute or two.

Conventions

  • Public operations use the cell_ prefix; constructors use hex_. Keep the API small and H3-like in naming.
  • Variable-size results are always tibbles that keep their source column (origin, parent); never switch return type based on input length.
  • Coordinates are longitude first, then latitude.
  • Raise errors with .abort() and a classed globalhex_error_* subclass, using cli formatting. Validate arguments with the helpers in R/conditions.R.
  • Deduplicate inputs and batch by resolution before calling DGGRID; avoid one subprocess per cell. Restore original order on output.
  • Long operations accept progress = NULL/TRUE/FALSE and use the internal .progress_* helpers.
  • The bundled DGGRID has no GDAL: use only TEXT/GEOJSON/AIGEN/SHAPEFILE inputs and outputs in metafiles, never GDAL types.
  • sf, terra, exactextractr, dggridR are Suggests only: guard with rlang::check_installed().
  • Internal helpers start with . and are documented with @noRd.
  • man/ and NAMESPACE are roxygen-generated; edit the roxygen comments, not the generated files.
  • Add a NEWS.md bullet for user-visible changes.

Implementation notes

  • Vector inputs are deduplicated before calling DGGRID and restored to input order afterwards. Hierarchy and traversal batch by resolution and depth.
  • Point, center, boundary, and sequence-number requests run in bounded chunks. Centers use DGGRID’s TEXT output; boundaries use GEOJSON.
  • Parent lookup is a local string operation on Z7/Z3 IDs (no DGGRID call).
  • Plotting picks a display level from cell centers, aggregates locally, and asks DGGRID for boundaries only for the final display cells. render = "auto" rasterizes at raster_threshold (20,000) cells when terra is available.
  • raster_to_cell() pads DGGRID’s nucleus-based cover by one neighbor ring, then drops cells not intersecting the raster footprint. Full-longitude rasters use whole-grid generation instead of a clipping polygon.

Open work

  • Replace subprocess-per-operation calls with a persistent process or a native dgaplib bridge.
  • Add fixtures for polygon covers spanning the antimeridian and holes at polar latitudes.
  • Consider a bounded neighbor/center cache if benchmarks show repeated lookups dominate real workloads.
  • Consider precomputed aggregation pyramids if interactive workloads outgrow the current LOD path.
  • Set up a pkgdown site.

Docs

README.md is generated from README.Rmd: edit the .Rmd and run devtools::build_readme(). Longer explanations belong in vignettes/, not the README. Vignettes must run quickly and guard optional packages with eval = requireNamespace(...).

Licensing

The package is AGPL-3.0-or-later because it bundles DGGRID. Third-party copyrights are listed in inst/COPYRIGHTS and Authors@R; update both when upgrading or adding bundled code. To upgrade DGGRID, replace the lib/ and apps/dggrid/ trees in src/dggrid/ from a pinned upstream commit, drop its CMake/Makefile files, and record the commit in inst/COPYRIGHTS and README.
